content:
We've curated the best picks from 9to5Toys' "Lunch Break Deals" this weekend. In addition to the various markdowns coinciding with Amazon's 2026 Labor Day sale, we'll also be tracking the AirPods Pro 3 discount of $50 off, as well as the AirTag 2 all-time low price of $20 each.

Other highlights include the iPhone 17 Pro hitting an all-time low on Amazon, with up to $290 off newer pricing, plus the first discounts on Apple's latest M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini. Keep reading for these and more—you'll also find deals on accessories, chargers, and smart home products.
